source: Mike's family tree (GEDCOM), a secondary source built from research. Census returns are the evidence.

people.name: Patrick McCadden
notes: Father of Patrick (Paddy) McCadden. Birth year ~1808 confirmed by death record (age 96). Irish and English speaker. Widower by 1901 - wife Catherine deceased. Living in Straness with son John in 1901. Oral tradition of brotherhood with Denis McCadden and Owen McCadden now supported by Griffith's evidence - Denis and Patrick listed as occupiers in same townland under same lessor c.1857. Surname also recorded as McAdam. Died aged ~96 - one of the oldest individuals in the dataset.

people.name: Rose Quinn
notes: Wife of Denis McCadden. Recorded as Rose McCadden (widow) in 1901 census, Straness, living with son Patrick (age 36) and his wife Ellen. Maiden name Quinn per family oral tradition. The Quinn cluster in Straness at Griffith's (~1857) - Charles Quinn, Bryan Quinn, Patrick Quinn, Daniel Quinn - likely her family.

people.name: John McCadden
notes: Son of Patrick McCadden Sr and Catherine. Remained in Straness while brother Paddy moved to Aghlem. Informant at father Patrick Sr's death 1904. Present in Straness 1901 with father. Not to be confused with John McCadden (, b.1882) who is his nephew.

people.name: Patrick McCadden
notes: Son of Denis McCadden and Rose Quinn. Living in Straness 1901 with wife Ellen and mother Rose Quinn (widow). Not to be confused with Patrick McCadden Sr (, b.~1808) or Patrick (Paddy) McCadden (, b.~1855).

people.name: Ellen
notes: Wife of Patrick McCadden (son of Denis McCadden). Surname unknown. Present in Straness 1901.

people.name: Cecelia Agnes McCadden
notes: Granddaughter of Denis McCadden through son Patrick (I50, b.~1865). Great-niece of Patrick McCadden Sr.
